description: A tool for formatting Rust code according to style guidelines.

option.name: --backup
tip: Backup any modified files.

option.name: --check
tip: Run in 'check' mode.
Exits with 0 if input is formatted correctly.
Exits with 1 and prints a diff if formatting is required.

option.name: --color
tip: Use colored output (if supported).

next.name: always
tip: Always colorize output

next.name: auto
tip: Colorize if output goes to a tty

next.name: never
tip: Never colorize output

option.name: --config
tip: Set options from the command line.
These settings take priority over .rustfmt.toml.
Run rustfmt --help=config to list all configuration options.

option.name: --config-path
tip: Recursively searches the given path for the rustfmt.toml config file.
If not found, reverts to the input file path.

option.name: --edition
tip: Rust edition to use.
Rust 2015 edition
Rust 2018 edition
Rust 2021 edition
Rust 2024 edition

option.name: --emit
tip: What data to emit and how.

next.name: files
tip: Write the formatted output to the original files

next.name: stdout
tip: Print the formatted output to stdout

option.name: --files-with-diff
tip: Prints the names of mismatched files that were formatted.
Prints the names of files that would be formatted when used with --check mode.

option.name: --print-config
tip: Dumps a default or minimal config to PATH.
A minimal config is the subset of the current config file used for formatting the current program.
current writes the current config to stdout as if formatting the file at PATH.

next.name: current
tip: Write the current configuration to stdout as if formatting the file at PATH

next.name: default
tip: Dump the default configuration to PATH

next.name: minimal
tip: Dump the minimal configuration used for the current program to PATH

option.name: --quiet
tip: Print less output.

option.name: --style-edition
tip: The edition of the Style Guide used for formatting.
Rust 2015 style edition
Rust 2018 style edition
Rust 2021 style edition
Rust 2024 style edition
Rust 2027 style edition (unstable)

global_option.name: --help
tip: Show this message or help about a specific topic.
Pass the topic attached to the long form: --help=config.

global_option.name: --verbose
tip: Print verbose output.

global_option.name: --version
tip: Show version information.
